title: Reduce noise in Devframe instance discovery
affectedWorkflow: An agent discovers the running Agent Hub instance before invoking its tools.
impact: The instance-list response occupies substantial context with information that is not needed to select an instance.

evidence.detail: The user reported that Devframe connect list instances overwhelms the agent's context relative to the information needed.

acceptance: The initial response makes the instance identity, connection state, and selection information easy to find.
Detailed metadata remains available through an explicit follow-up when needed.
Compare representative responses before and after the change rather than inventing a reduction metric.
